steps.content: On the training ground, S9 immerses herself fully in her tasks. Such military training, long absent from her life, seems to evoke memories of her past.
Meanwhile, somewhere out of her sight, a car is quietly slipping away from the Bureau.
[Scene Change] Inside a vehicle

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The handover to the 9th Agency has been arranged. The vehicle will follow the established route. Even if S9 notices, we've prepared decoys, so she won't be a problem.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Focus on your mission and keep it under wraps. Don't worry about anything else.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood.
You end the call and look up at the two ladies before you.
They sit across from you in the car, the atmosphere thick with tension.
After a brief moment of silence, you avert your gaze from them and address the driver.
(Black screen, sound of the engine starting)
(Scene change)

Eugene recalls that earlier this morning, Wynn said he would have bad luck today and advised against taking on any arrest missions. That's why he specifically chose what he thought would be a safe assignment.
But he never expected what would happen next.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Ugh—Let me go! Who are you?!
The liason agents who were supposed to come didn't show up. Instead, a group of men in suits block the road, force Eugene out of the car, and pin him roughly to the ground.
As one of the enemies reaches for the back door, Eugene lets out a furious roar.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Stay away from them!!
The door opens, followed by the emergence of a handgun. The Chief of Minos stands defensively before the vehicle, shielding the two people behind.
The leading figure raises his hands in a gesture of feigned surrender, offering you a smile.

steps.speaker: Man in Suit
steps.content: Greetings, Chief of Minos. We have received confidential intelligence regarding a possible kidnapping or death threat to you, so we rushed here to guarantee your safety. Our apologies for any inconvenience this may cause.

steps.speaker: Man in Suit
steps.content: For the safety of you and the ladies behind you, perhaps we should have a talk somewhere else. Come with us, Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can protect myself. We don't need your help. And who exactly are you people?

steps.speaker: Man in Suit
steps.content: I'm sorry, but we can't say anything here. Your safety remains at risk, and this place is far from secure.

steps.speaker: Man in Suit
steps.content: If you won't go... then I'm afraid the two behind you will have to come with us instead.
As the man converses with you with a smile, his companions fixate on the two in the vehicle with predatory gazes, akin to hyenas coveting their prey.
You pause for a moment.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief! Don't go with them! I've sent a signal, and help will be here soon! Don't—ugh!
A forceful blow silences him. Your fists tighten with anger, taking a long moment to slowly unclench.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't hurt him.
With evident satisfaction, the well-dressed man opens the door of the luxury car for you.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: (Cough cough)... Chief... Don't...
You shoot Eugene a cautionary glance, silently advising him against doing anything rash.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you are not to hurt anyone.

steps.speaker: Man in Suit
steps.content: As you wish, Chief. This way, please.
Jelena's face turns deathly pale as she holds Elvira tightly in her embrace, as if to shield her from the sight of such raw malice.
Navigating through the intimidating crowd, you position yourself protectively in front of the two as you enter their vehicle.
